name: dev
description: A development workflow as a chained skill pipeline over one ai_docs/ workspace: prime the codebase, brainstorm a design, analyze it from eight perspectives, break it into SLC phases, write a zero-context implementation plan, execute it in batches with reviewer subagents or a swarm, verify against the plan, review from eleven perspectives, describe the change, and hand off. Bundles four agents (codebase-locator, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder, code-reviewer). Adapted in part from obra/superpowers, HumanLayer, wshobson/agents and BMAD-METHOD; see NOTICE.md.
